title: channel-profile
description: channel_profiles/<slug>/channel.json — the only place a channel's identity, render numbers, and stage sequence live. Stage contracts describe process; they read numbers from here and never hardcode them. If a contract and this file disagree, this file wins for that channel.

slug.description: must match the channel_profiles/<slug> and episodes/<slug> folder name

reference_bible_path.description: path to this channel's local, self-contained brand/cast/compliance copy; treated as immutable reference

image.description: Two distinct image jobs: reference sheets at 04b/04c (identity locks, a handful per episode) and frame-0 stills at 04f2 (one per clip, the literal first frame). Never mix image generators inside one episode.

pipeline_stages.description: ordered list of stage ids this channel walks; each id must have a matching pipeline/stages/<id>.md

generation_unit.description: Universally the clip: one still, one prompt, one fixed-duration generation. There is no per-channel scene-versus-shot choice.

clip_duration_seconds.description: vidgen-dist takes duration as a global app setting in SECONDS and derives the frame count internally as 1 + floor(fps*duration/8)*8, satisfying LTX-2.5's num_frames%8==1 rule.

spoken_word_band.description: Quoted words per clip at the channel's planning pace. Enforced by LTXV-D034.

style_echo.description: The channel's trailing style sentence. Passed to the validator so LTXV-D041 can exclude it when locating the clip's final action beat.
